svg.title: KAREN OS GitHub Projects Engineering HQ architecture
svg.desc: One GitHub Project shows issues and pull requests from independent repositories. The owner labels issues status:ready and merges pull requests; KAREN OS rules let agents start only status:ready issues. Moving a Project card never starts an agent. The daily digest reads GitHub directly and works without the Project.
svg.text: KAREN OS · GitHub Projects Engineering HQ
One planning view across independent repositories. Issue labels authorise work; moving a card does not.
Triage and plan on the board
Planning and visibility only. Status mirrors the labels.
Same issues and PRs as the repos, linked, never copied.
Backlog → Ready → In Progress → Review → Done
Independent repositories (each keeps its own history)
✕ a card move never starts an agent
Blue = your authority · red dashed = no authority · dashed box = later
